verdict.comment: American Affair is a major player but Nazron and JM JUNGLE are viable alternatives.

comments.americanaffair: Giant strides last year; better than ever on reappearance; looks a Group horse in waiting
comments.finewine: Won this race in 2022; regressed since but latest Musselburgh third was better
comments.jmjungle: Boasts strong handicap form here; behind American Affair on return but still a big player
comments.lethalnymph: On losing run and failed to fire last time; tough race in which to end his drought
comments.monnaslieve: Turf win last month but two runs since suggest he has his work cut out; new blinkers today
comments.mondammej: Four AW wins over the winter but he'd be a surprise winner here
comments.nazron: Handicapped to win & latest run hugely promising; in deeper today but still unexposed
comments.pilgrim: Royal Ascot win last summer on the only occasion he's had 5f and fast ground; has C&D form
comments.shagraan: Tough sprinter; solid return at Goodwood two weeks ago; ran well here last year; contender
comments.spartanarrow: Looked smart at Epsom latest (cheekpieces first time); up 7lb but still has low mileage
comments.teesspirit: Two runs this year suggest he'll do well to better last season's fifth in this race
comments.tocamadera: Didn't build on his reappearance 2nd when 6th at Goodwood latest; work to do with Shagraan
comments.trilby: Still well treated but fast 5f on fast ground may not be the conditions for him to show it
comments.vantheman: Ran a stormer at this meeting last year; sharper for last month's return; interesting
comments.venturaexpress: Running well in defeat this year but surprising if there weren't a few better treated
comments.vincelamour: C&D win in October came on soft; finished behind a few of these at Musselburgh last time
comments.vintageclarets: Best run this year when 3rd at Ripon last month; likely vulnerable on today's ground
comments.zouluchief: Course win as a 2yo (6f); promising 3rd at Ascot last time & now has something to build on

races.raceComment: americanaffair is marginally preferred with a score of 60.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive over spartanarrow. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 3 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 6/19 at york. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: High numbers often advantaged on straight course in big fields

verdict.comment: The well-bred and lightly raced 4yo STANAGE (nap) still has lots of potential upside and is the selection ahead of Northern Express.

comments.alzahir: Won two in a row earlier this spring; two losses since, which knock him down pecking order
comments.blueforyou: Last three wins have come over C&D; reappearance third at Haydock bodes extremely well
comments.ceruleanbay: Hat-trick last summer; may have needed comeback run, but has to take sizeable step forward
comments.cruyffturn: Arrives in good form; won this in 2022 but a long time since he's threatened here
comments.dingle: 1m AW wins the last twice but he's 6-21 on AW as opposed to 0-14 on grass
comments.latrinidad: Returned with fine 3rd at Thirsk but it's a long time since he won here; may be vulnerable
comments.mrking: On a handy mark and had an excuse when a well-backed favourite in the Thirsk Hunt Cup
comments.northernexpress: Went close in this 12 months ago and the reapplied cheekpieces could be a plus; player
comments.oldcock: Made it 3-5 last August; hasn't kicked on since but not written off back on better ground
comments.romieu: Made it 2-3 on British debut; in at deep end on handicap debut but could be up to the task
comments.sisyphean: Impressive over C&D last July and could make a bold bid under Ryan Moore on reappearance
comments.stanage: Lightly raced 4yo who made a really good start to his season and had an excuse last time
comments.stormcatcher: Seven-time AW winner but current form and the suitability of turf are the doubts
comments.themepark: C&D winner who will be suited by the expected competitive gallop in this big field
comments.urbansprawl: In fair form on turf on his last three starts but may be vulnerable in his hot handicap

races.raceComment: alzahir is marginally preferred with a score of 58.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions over urbansprawl. Won 2 of last 6 starts, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to KANDOR (nap), who won here over hurdles and ran his best race over fences when a close fourth over C&D last month.

comments.everydaychampagne: In good form last summer (2nd twice here) but rather lost his way and pulled up last twice
comments.fetechampetre: Three fair races for new trainer; could go well but stamina to prove on first try at 3m
comments.kandor: Won hurdle here in 2024; best of 4 chase runs when 1.75l fourth over C&D latest; contender
comments.noregrets: Kelso win in visor last March; bit disappointing since; needs to bounce back after a break
comments.peejaybee: Course winner; back to winning way last time at Ffos Las; interesting off 5lb higher
comments.saintarvans: Last win was over C&D in June 2023 (good); on a good mark; needs to improve on recent form
comments.whistleinthedark: Won four in a row at up to 2m5f two seasons ago; fair run two starts back; bit to prove

races.raceComment: peejaybee is marginally preferred with a score of 61.5%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form over saintarvans. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 7/23 at perth. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and positive comments, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The choice is ISABELLA CASTILE (nap) who is 1lb well in following a narrow defeat on her AW debut here ten days ago.

comments.alkhawssaa: Pulled her chance away on last month's return but showed good form on the AW last year
comments.bridgetsview: C&D winner who makes her handicap debut after six months off; drawn widest
comments.cypriotdiaspora: Hasn't shone in three goes on the AW and is yet to prove she wants this far
comments.dashofazure: Second in all three starts last year; makes handicap debut after 197 days off; respected
comments.gaietymusical: Four wins from nine starts on AW this year; shorter trip and wide draw pose a question
comments.isabellacastile: Beaten a neck on AW debut here ten days ago; a player off the same mark (1lb well in)
comments.ladyofandros: 1-6 for Andre Fabre; makes stable/AW debut after seven months off and worth a market check
comments.liberalised: Well held in three starts for this yard and improvement needed now switched to a handicap
comments.powdering: Mainly seen on Tapeta; not handicapped out of things, but isn't drawn to advantage
comments.primrosepath: Off 162 days since winning at Lingfield and the draw hasn't been kind
comments.rockymountainway: Dual turf winner last summer; has run well over C&D; may have needed last month's return
comments.searchingtheblues: Twice disappointing since winning twice on the AW last summer; plenty to prove
comments.stellenbosch: Placed in her first three starts, but well held on handicap debut; needs to bounce back
comments.thursdayschild: Didn't show a lot on her stable debut/return over 6f here last month; best look elsewhere

races.raceComment: gaietymusical is marginally preferred with a score of 48.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over powdering. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 2 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Typically open. ARCTIC DAWN was nicely clear of an in-form Drifts Away last time and the selection looks ready for a mile.

comments.arcticdawn: Kept boxing on for pressure when second over 7f last time and looks ready for a mile
comments.atarangi: Overcame a wide stall to race prominently and win nicely over C&D last month
comments.beylerbeyi: Tailed off in two hurdle races during the winter; won his last Flat start off 5lb lower
comments.courtofsession: Well held in his six races since moving yards and not beaten a rival in his last two
comments.distinction: Penultimate run was a positive one but always vulnerable to something more progressive
comments.downtothekid: Completed a Southwell hat-trick at this trip in good style two weeks ago
comments.driftsaway: Four-timer came up shy but Brandon Wilkie returns with his 3lb claim and that can help
comments.glamsquad: 3-10; only 4lb higher than for last win and appeals as a horse with more to offer
comments.greatblasket: Quiet this season but competitive mark if he can get himself back on track
comments.jodhpurblue: Should pay his way in handicaps but perhaps best watched here on first run since October
comments.sunnycorner: Didn't run too badly back from a break at Brighton and should be sharper this time
comments.superposition: Given every chance when a well-held fourth off this mark at Pontefract

races.raceComment: driftsaway is confidently preferred with a score of 62.2%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over downtothekid. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 3 wins from 9 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 5/13 at kempton. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws favored on polytrack, particularly in sprints

verdict.comment: Currumbin and Gooloogong are considered but CAPRELO steps up in trip with headgear fitted and he retains some potential.

comments.capone: Did well in 2023; ran to form in just one of three starts last year; absent ten months
comments.caprelo: Course win (1m3f) last year; sharper for reappearance and steps up in trip with potential
comments.currumbin: Progressive stayer on AW this winter; below par on turf latest but can quickly bounce back
comments.donaldllewellyn: Conditions to suit but he ran poorly here when last seen and others look safer
comments.doublethetrouble: Conditions to suit but fully exposed and vulnerable to improvers
comments.gooloogong: Got messed about when well backed at Goodwood latest; yard in form; can do better
comments.kingdomofstars: Unexposed handicap debutant but the step up to 2m not sure to suit (dam a sprinter)
comments.moelarthur: 2m win at Lingfield in January but he's found it tougher going since

races.raceComment: doublethetrouble is marginally preferred with a score of 57.6%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over moelarthur. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
